heading: 范氏義莊規矩 Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju · Fan Lineage Charitable Estate Rules · 范氏義莊規矩 · 建立義莊規矩 (范純仁奏) … 文正公𥘉定規矩 35

items.text: Give every household a monthly rice allowance per head and a yearly winter clothing allowance.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 逐房計口給米每口一升...冬衣每口一疋十歲以下五歲以上各半疋

items.text: Provide a monthly rice allowance for a female servant who has children at home and is fifteen or older, and for one servant per household; give no clothing.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 女使有兒女在家及十五年...聽給米...每房許給奴婢米一口即不支衣
items.conflict: Regulates bondservants as property; Scripture calls masters to treat servants justly and fellow believers as brothers, not as chattel.

items.text: Give thirty strings for a daughter's wedding and twenty for her remarriage; give twenty for a son's wedding, but nothing for a second wife.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 嫁女支錢三十貫...再嫁二十貫...娶婦支錢二十貫再娶不支

items.text: Pay funeral and burial costs for each household's dead by seniority and age: a senior receives ten strings at death and fifteen at burial, a junior five and ten, a minor seven or less, and nothing for children under seven or servants.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 尊長有喪先支一十貫至葬事又支一十五貫...七歳以下及婢僕皆不支

items.text: When relatives or in-laws face sudden hardship or famine, the branches shall verify the need and aid them from the estate grain.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 外姻親戚如貧窘中非次急難或遇年饑不能度日...量行濟助

items.text: Give each young clansman who actually sits for the great examination ten strings, half for a second attempt; if he fails to appear without cause, recover the money.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 諸位子弟得大比試者每人支錢一十貫文...已給而無故不試者追納

items.text: Choose two clansmen of learning and conduct as teachers and give each five shi of brown rice monthly; if the pupils are fewer than six, give three.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 諸位子弟内選二人充諸位教授月給糙米五石

items.text: Administer the estate strictly by the rules; let no clansman, even an elder, interfere.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 義莊事惟聽掌管人依規處置其族人雖是尊長不得侵擾干預
items.needs_role: steward/manager of the charitable estate (掌管人)

items.text: Do not embezzle or lend the estate's money or grain; if you misuse it, repay it and do not deduct it from your monthly rice.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 掌管人侵欺...償納不得以月給米折除

items.text: Do not rent the estate fields, occupy its granary, or borrow its labor, boats, carts, or tools.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 族人不得租佃義田...義莊人力船車噐用之類諸位不得借用

items.text: Register every birth of a son or daughter with the estate within two months; if you fail, the child will not be counted for rice later.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 諸位生男女限兩月...報義莊...過限不報後雖年長不理爲口數給米

items.text: In famine years give only monthly rice, not clothing or other grants; if there is surplus, pay funerals first, then weddings, then winter clothing.
items.citation: Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju, 文正公初定規矩 35
items.quote: 若遇凶荒除給餱粮外一切不支...先凶後吉

heading: 范氏義莊規矩 Fanshi Yizhuang Guiju · Fan Lineage Charitable Estate Rules · 范氏義莊規矩 · 續定規矩 清憲公奏 … 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11

items.text: Do not graze sheep or cut timber on the ancestors' burial grounds.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 族人輙敢於上牧羊及偷斫林木柴薪 — kinsmen dare to graze sheep and steal firewood there.

items.text: Support the temple where offerings are made for the ancestors and do not let the incense fire cease.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 爲子孫者所當相與扶持不廢香火 — Descendants ought to support it and not let the incense fire cease.
items.conflict: Conflicts with Deuteronomy 18:10-12 and the prohibition of offerings to the dead.

items.text: Do not lease or plant the charitable estate's fields under another name, seize them from tenants, or block irrigation.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 諸房不得租種義莊田土 — The branches may not lease or plant the estate fields.

items.text: Treat the estate tenants generously so they can keep their work, and do not force overpriced goods on them.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 義莊租戶所當優䘏使之安業 — The estate tenants should be kindly treated and kept settled.

items.text: Though you are elders, do not meddle or interfere with the estate manager's handling of estate affairs.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 雖是尊長不得侵擾干預 — even elders may not meddle or interfere.

items.text: Do not act only for bribes or against the estate's interests, appoint troublemakers to offices or labor, or open the granaries to misuse grain.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 專爲貨賂不顧義莊利害 — intent only on bribes, heedless of the estate's good.

items.text: Do not embezzle the estate's funds or property; if you do, repay before drawing your allowance again.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 掌莊子弟侵欺徑行申官理㫁勒令陪塡 — If the estate manager embezzles, he is reported and made to repay.

items.text: Do not commit adultery, theft, gambling, brawling, or fraud that disgraces the family; if you do not reform, you may be expelled and reported for banishment.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 姦盗賭闘毆 — adultery, theft, gambling, and brawling.

items.text: Do not pass off an outside-surname child as your own to draw the monthly allowance, or give your own son away and then take him back to draw.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 輙取異姓以爲巳子冐請月米者勿給 — Taking a child of another surname as one's own to draw rice is not allowed.

items.text: Do not build private houses on the estate grounds reserved for the clan's common dwelling.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 不許族人占造私宅等用 — kinsmen are not allowed to occupy it and build private dwellings.

items.text: Grant examination travel funds to sons who pass the provincial examination or enter the Imperial College to encourage their studies.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 如有子弟得觧赴省義莊支官㑹一伯千 — If a son passes the provincial exam, the estate pays him a hundred strings.

items.text: Use the study hall only for studying, and do not feast or lodge there except in examination years.
items.citation: 范氏義莊規矩, 續定規矩 清憲公奏 11
items.quote: 歳寒堂除科舉年分諸位子弟暫請𨽻業餘時不得於内飲宴安泊 — Except in examination years, they may not feast or lodge there.
